Optional Research Informed Consent

Optional Research Document
This optional research consent is separate from the required HIPAA Authorization. You may decline optional research consent and still complete this consent flow.

OPTIONAL RESEARCH INFORMED CONSENT

Your participation in this study is voluntary. You may decide not to participate or you may leave the study at any time. Your decision will not result in any penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled.

If you have questions, concerns, or complaints, or think this research has hurt you, talk to the research team at the phone number(s) listed in this document.

There is a possibility that identifiers might be removed from your private information or biospecimens and then used or distributed for future research studies without your additional informed consent.

Quest Diagnostics and the Quest family of companies are committed to supporting you in making changes and improving your health by offering comprehensive screening tests and employee wellness programs. Research is an important part of how we make new discoveries that guide our employee wellness program options so that we achieve our program goals.

Below is a summary of this research study including key information. Please read the entire consent form before deciding if you want to participate.

Key Information

  • The purpose of this research study is to develop new insights into how employee wellness programs, like Blueprint For Wellness (BFW), impacts the health and wellness of our employees and their spouses/domestic partners (“BFW participants”).
  • You are being invited to join this study because you are a Quest employee or an employee’s spouse/domestic partner signing up for BFW.
  • If you join this study, you agree to allow Quest Diagnostics to use certain information, like your answers provided to BFW questions, your employment information and your test results, to perform research described in this consent specifically related to employee wellness programs.
  • Quest Diagnostics, Pack Health, and the Quest Welfare Plan, including the medical plan and BFW, will share eligible BFW participants’ information with qualified academic researchers from Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Sloan School of Management and the Gies College of Business, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign or in scientific publications in a way that cannot identify you.
  • There is no direct benefit to you for joining this study. Your participation may help advance scientific knowledge about employee wellness programs, which may or may not benefit all Quest BFW participants in the future.
  • There are no physical risks to participating, however there is a small risk that someone could learn about your personal information without permission like in the case of a privacy breach.
  • Participation in this research is voluntary and you may choose not to participate. Your decision not to participate will not be held against you or affect your access to Quest Diagnostics products or services, including BFW.
  • You can change your mind about participating at any time. If you decide not to participate in this research or withdraw from the research, your employment with Quest will not be affected.

Indicate below that you have read this information and understand.

I have read this information and understand.

claude.md — Consent Form (User Consent, 973795360)

Purpose: participant-facing consent capture, reached via an emailed/texted link keyed by session_id + company_score (+ consent_language as of Aug 2026). Own session, separate from the agent's.

Node map: 4 Get Consent (root, resolves company_score+consent_language -> consent text/company/client name/client ID) -> 1 Consent display + authorize checkbox + signature -> 5 branch on company_score (healthyquest only) -> 3 Optional Research Informed Consent (HealthyQuest participants only) -> 2 completion.

Data dictionary: company_score (19 values) -> consent_en/consent_es/company/client name/client ID via node 4's inverseClientData (mirrors node 17/6 of the Agent Workflow tree -- keep all three in sync). consent_language ("English"/"Spanish") arrives via the zv_consent_language URL parameter set by the Agent tree's node 6.

Known gaps: node 3's Optional Research Informed Consent (HealthyQuest only) has no Spanish version -- English only, out of scope for this CR. Same 3-client Spanish gap as the Agent tree (see its claude.md). parker_hannifin_2026_myguide has no consent_es (English fallback) and an empty client ID (pending from Quest); healthyquest consent_es is one revision behind its 2026 English text. Field name signature is reused on both node 1 and node 3 -- a HealthyQuest participant who signs both overwrites the first value (pre-existing, not touched).

Changelog

  • 2026-08-20 -- inverseClientData now carries consent_en/consent_es per client (14 of 18), sourced from Rachel A. Hardin's "Consents for Zingtree 2.xlsx"; resolves against consent_language forwarded from the Agent tree. Retired the "Cigna Consent Spanish 2020" key -- folded into "cigna_consent". Node 1 now displays the chosen language.
  • 2026-08-31 -- (1) healthyquest_bfw_hipaa_authorization_08292025 consent_en updated to the approved 2026 BFW HIPAA Authorization (Mike Marks email 8/29/2026, "Quest - BFW - HIPAA Authorization 2026.pdf"): claims administrators now include Priority Health and Kaiser; "smoking cessation" -> "nicotine cessation"; phone/formatting fixes. consent_es intentionally left on the prior revision -- no updated Spanish received from Quest. (2) Added parker_hannifin_2026_myguide to inverseClientData (Rachel A. Hardin email 8/21/2026, "Parker Hannifin Disclosure-Attestation.docx", program "2026 MyGuide"): Unum disclosure attestation, English only, client ID pending from Quest; no dedicated branch -- node 5 default routes Parker to completion like other non-HealthyQuest clients. Source docs verbatim; authorization captured via node 1's existing checkbox + signature (the doc's printed Yes/No answer is represented by the checkbox -- flagged to Quest if an explicit "No" record is required).
